Metadata.title: PokéType
Metadata.description: Online typing races to practise in French and English.

Home.title: PokéType
Home.welcome: Welcome! Practise typing fast and accurately by racing against your friends.
Home.joinRoomHint: Choose your trainer name to join your friend's room.

NotFound.heading: Page not found
NotFound.message: This page does not exist or has been moved.

Footer.notice: PokéType is a non-commercial educational school project.
Footer.rights: Pokémon names and images belong to Nintendo, Game Freak and The Pokémon Company.
Footer.affiliation: This project is not affiliated with them.

GuestEntry.heading: Start your adventure
GuestEntry.label: Your trainer name
GuestEntry.hint: {min} to {max} characters: letters, digits, spaces and hyphens.

errors.length: Your name must be between {min} and {max} characters.
errors.characters: Use only letters, digits, spaces and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.

Room.heading: Waiting room
Room.inviteHint: Send this link to a friend so they can join you.
Room.notFoundMessage: This room does not exist or is no longer available.
Room.raceStartedMessage: You can no longer join this room. Create your own room from the play page.
Room.gone: This room is no longer available.
Room.startFailed: The race could not be started. Try again.
Room.hostWillStart: The host will start the race.
Room.typingWaits: You can type at the start signal.

ServerError.heading: Something went wrong
ServerError.message: A problem happened on our side. Try again in a moment.

SignUp.heading: Create an account
SignUp.noticeNoEmail: No email address needed: a username and a password are enough.
SignUp.noticeNoRecovery: If you forget your password, nobody can get it back.
SignUp.noticeWriteDown: Write it down somewhere safe or ask an adult to help you keep it.
SignUp.usernameHint: {min} to {max} characters: letters without accents, digits, hyphens (-) and underscores (_).

username.length: Your username must be between {min} and {max} characters.
username.characters: Use only letters without accents, digits, hyphens (-) and underscores (_).
username.taken: This name is already taken. Choose another one.

password.tooShort: Your password must have at least {min} characters.
password.tooLong: Your password must have at most {max} characters.

confirmation.required: Enter your password a second time.
confirmation.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

form.busy: Many players are creating an account right now. Try again in a few seconds.
form.alreadyAccount: This browser has already created an account. Log in with your username and password.
